# inverz

Reverse DayZ and BattlEye identifiers through local indexes.

## NAME

**inverz**

## SYNOPSIS

`inverz [OPTIONS]`

## OPTIONS

### Application Options

|Option|Description|Default|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`-d`, `--data-dir`|Application data directory||`$INVERZ_DATA_DIR`|no|
|`--cache-max-size`|Maximum SQLite cache footprint (KiB, MiB, or GiB)|`512MiB`|`$INVERZ_CACHE_MAX_SIZE`|no|

### Env Options

|Option|Description|Default|Required|
|---|---|---|---|
|`--env-file FILE`|Path to .env file|`.env`|no|
|`--no-env`|Disable .env file loading||no|
|`--env-override`|Override existing environment variables from .env file||no|

### Help Options

|Option|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`-h`, `--help`|Show this help message|no|
|`-v`, `--version`|Show version information|no|

### generate

Build a local index profile

**Usage:** `inverz [OPTIONS] generate [generate-OPTIONS]`

#### Examples

Build a small DayZ profile

```shell
inverz generate --max-steamid 76561197960265759 dayz
```

**Aliases:** gen

#### Build a local index profile

|Option|Description|Default|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`-e`, `--estimate`|Print resource estimates without generating files||`$INVERZ_ESTIMATE`|no|
|`--force`|Rebuild existing segments instead of reusing them|||no|
|`-m`, `--min-steamid`|Minimum SteamID64|`76561197960265728`|`$INVERZ_MIN_STEAMID`|no|
|`-M`, `--max-steamid`|Maximum SteamID64|`76561200107749375`|`$INVERZ_MAX_STEAMID`|no|
|`-j`, `--jobs`|Total generator CPU budget; zero uses GOMAXPROCS|`0`|`$INVERZ_JOBS`|no|
|`-k`, `--rice-k`|Rice parameter; omitted value is prefix-bits minus one|`-1`|`$INVERZ_RICE_K`; default mask: `-`|no|
|`-p`, `--prefix-bits`|Digest prefix width|`18`|`$INVERZ_PREFIX_BITS`|no|
|`-s`, `--segment-bits`|AccountID segment width|`28`|`$INVERZ_SEGMENT_BITS`|no|

### hash

Calculate identifiers from SteamID64

**Usage:** `inverz [OPTIONS] hash [hash-OPTIONS]`

#### Calculate identifiers from SteamID64

|Option|Description|Default|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`-f`, `--format`|Output format; choices: `text, json`|`text`|`$INVERZ_FORMAT`|no|

### hash battleye

Calculate BattlEye GUIDs

**Usage:** `inverz [OPTIONS] hash [hash-OPTIONS] battleye`

#### Examples

Hash several SteamIDs as text

```shell
inverz hash battleye 76561197960265728 76561197960265729 76561197960265730
```

Extract BattlEye GUIDs from batch JSON output

```shell
inverz hash battleye --format json 76561197960265728 76561197960265729 76561197960265730 | jq -r '.[].battleye_guid'
```

**Aliases:** be

#### Arguments

|Name|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`STEAMID`|SteamID64 values|yes|

### hash dayz

Calculate DayZ identifiers

**Usage:** `inverz [OPTIONS] hash [hash-OPTIONS] dayz`

#### Examples

Hash several SteamIDs as text

```shell
inverz hash dayz 76561197960265728 76561197960265729 76561197960265730
```

Extract DayZ IDs from batch JSON output

```shell
inverz hash dayz --format json 76561197960265728 76561197960265729 76561197960265730 | jq -r '.[].dayz_id'
```

**Aliases:** dz

#### Arguments

|---|---|---|
|`STEAMID`|SteamID64 values|yes|

### query battleye

Resolve BattlEye GUIDs

**Usage:** `inverz [OPTIONS] query [query-OPTIONS] battleye`

#### Examples

Resolve several BattlEye GUIDs in one request

```shell
inverz query battleye 4fc867abf98b934e9e7eeaf15170258c 74ae012b5407e0a3cc2cd82ec1f8ba7d 0cc99e3ab77a8a2037d278816f3c9ca7
```

Keep resolved SteamIDs from batch JSON output

```shell
inverz query battleye --format json 4fc867abf98b934e9e7eeaf15170258c 74ae012b5407e0a3cc2cd82ec1f8ba7d | jq -r '.[] | .steam_id // empty'
```

**Aliases:** be

#### Arguments

|Name|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`GUID`|BattlEye GUIDs|yes|
